contract:
Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::orderItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentOrderProduct: OrderProduct = self.CurrentOrderProduct,
		selectedItem: Item = Item.allInstances()->any(candidate: Item|candidate.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		currentOrderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		selectedItem.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let entry: OrderEntry in
		entry.oclIsNew() and
		OrderEntry.allInstances()->includes(entry) and
		entry.Item = selectedItem and
		entry.Quantity = quantity and
		entry.SubAmount = quantity*selectedItem.OrderPrice and
		currentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries->includes(entry) and
		result = true
}
